guide.arz_classes.empty: §7A guide for this class is coming soon.
guide.arz_classes.footer: §7You can return to the guide at any time: use the 'Guide' button in the classes window.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.miner.2: Mining ore gives XP. The rarer the ore, the more XP per block: coal gives a little, while diamonds and ancient debris give much more.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.miner.4: When you mine ore with a pickaxe without Silk Touch, coal, iron and gold drop 1 extra raw item. The bonus is unlocked by skills in the tree.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.miner.7: §7The miner's helmet has a built-in lamp that lights your way underground.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.miner.8: The "Headlamp" skill unlocks the helmet recipe: a lantern, two leather and five gold ingots. Other classes can neither craft nor wear it.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.miner.10: The Combat Miner hits harder with a pickaxe and sees in the dark. The Clan Farmer can smelt ore the moment it is mined and later mine netherite.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.2: Working the land gives XP: harvesting crops, killing animals and cooking.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.5: §7The Bone Pouch is a Farmer item, unlocked by the skill of the same name.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.6: The pouch stores bone meal: the amount inside is shown in the item tooltip. Press Shift + Right-click to open it. While it holds bone meal it fertilizes nearby farmland, so you do not have to bone-meal each plot by hand. Its range can be increased: the Cook subclass widens it with its skills.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.7: The "Instant Growth" skill makes a single bone meal enough to fully grow a crop.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.10: §7Golden versions of crops: wheat, potato, beetroot, cabbage, onion, tomato and rice.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.11: The "Rare Harvest" skill gives a chance to get a golden version of a crop when harvesting a ripe plant. The chance is small, about 1% per skill, and grows with your class progress and for the Cook. Tomatoes are harvested with Right-click, while golden rice drops when you cut a rice panicle on a cutting board, where the chance is even lower, at most 2%.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.13: Auto-Replant plants a harvested crop again right away.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.14: The "Plots" skill unlocks the Farmer's Delight rich soil recipe, made from dirt and organic compost.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.farmer.16: The Cook gives food quality stars and is the only one who can use the Farmer's Delight cooking pot. The Drunkard brews alcohol and improves its quality.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.mystic.2: Magic gives XP: enchanting items and working with rings.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.mystic.4: Skills lower the level required for enchanting, raise the maximum enchantment level, add XP from mobs and calm endermen: they will not attack even if you look them in the eye.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.mystic.5: Only the Mystic can craft the enchanting table and rings. Rings give a bonus to class XP and are worn in the ring slot.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.mystic.6: The iron ring is unlocked by a skill at level 4, the gold ring at level 9. The netherite ring will come later. Rings need rarity fragments: Rare for iron, Epic for gold, Legendary for netherite.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.mystic.8: The Enchanter sees possible enchantments at the table in advance and can reroll them. The Alchemist works with a mortar and pestle and strengthens potions.
Chopping naturally grown trees gives XP. Logs placed by players and leaves give none.
The "Chance of Coal" skill (level 3) gives a chance to find coal and unlocks firewood crafting: an iron axe and an oak log make four pieces.
Leaves can drop extra loot. The "Timber!" skill fells a whole tree if you hold an axe: the more logs, the longer it takes.
At level 4 the carpenter's workbench unlocks: the Lumberjack uses it to craft chests from different wood types.
§7A furnace with an extra firewood slot to the right of the result slot.
Put firewood in this slot and the furnace works 1.5 times faster. One log lasts for 4 smelted items, and the bar above the slot shows how much of the current log is left.
Firewood works only in a regular furnace. The Lumberjack crafts it, but anyone can use it.
The Carpenter lands softly and can use the woodcutter. The Jaeger sees in the dark and runs faster at night, and finds more coal when chopping.
guide.arz_classes.crafting.2: Here we will explain how crafting works: what you can make, which tools and materials you need, and how classes affect crafting.
guide.arz_classes.crafting.3: Details will be added later. Stay tuned!
Crafting gives XP: making tools, weapons and armor, sharpening and repairing. The more precise your hit in the minigame, the more XP.
§7The smithing table is a class block. Only the Blacksmith can sharpen and repair on it.
Go to the table, hold the item in your main hand and press Shift + Right-click on the table. A hammer in your off-hand starts sharpening; a suitable material starts a repair.
§7The sharpening and repair window: the slider moves along the bar, with colored hit zones in the center.
Press SPACE when the slider is in the center. The more precise the hit, the better the result.
Sharpening: a perfect hit raises the sharpening level. A medium hit costs 25% durability, a bad one 75%, with no sharpening. A miss drops durability to 1. Learn the "Tool Sharpening" skill first.

Repair: a perfect hit restores the maximum, a medium hit half, a bad hit a quarter. On a miss the repair fails and you keep the material. If the item has almost no durability left, only a perfect hit can repair it: on a miss it breaks.

Repair materials go in your off-hand: ingots and nuggets of the item's metal, diamond shards, netherite scrap, sticks (bow and crossbow) and prismarine shards (trident). Wooden and stone gear cannot be repaired or sharpened.
Only the Blacksmith can craft the iron and copper hammers. Their recipes are in the recipe book, the "Recipes" button in the classes window.

When crafting gear, the Blacksmith can roll a higher rarity: the rarity wheel spins first. Higher rarity means stronger stats and more durability. You can upgrade the rarity of a finished item at the rarity upgrade table using shards.
The Armorer specializes in armor: sharpening, durability, netherite armor. The Weaponsmith specializes in weapons and tools. Both unlock Legendary and Mythic rarity.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.common.2: Each level grants one skill point. Skills unlock in order: click the next node in the tree on the right to spend a point.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.common.3: A subclass fork appears in the tree at level 10. You can choose a subclass only once the server opens the choice; while it is closed, XP stops counting at level 9.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.common.4: The subclass choice is permanent: the other branch is closed for good.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.common.5: Changing your class completely resets the level, XP, subclass and skills of the previous class.
guide.arz_classes.class_info.common.6: Hover over the XP bar to see the exact amount of XP.
